instruction: VLC keeps asking me about privacy and network policy settings every time I launch it, which is annoying during my study sessions. Could you configure VLC to stop showing the privacy policy prompt at startup?

parameters.window_name: lecture.pdf — 6.006 Introduction to Algorithms, Lecture 2: Data Structures

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires user to disable VLC's privacy policy prompt (qt-privacy-ask=0). The evaluator uses custom check_qt_privacy_ask__132d5c78 metric to verify that qt-privacy-ask setting is set to 0 in VLC config file.
metadata.verification: Verified with custom function check_qt_privacy_ask__132d5c78. Expected value: qt-privacy-ask=0 (don't ask). Default is 1 (ask).
